cases.prompt: I need licensed child care for a toddler in Richmond, VA. What options are there?
cases.description: Finds licensed child care by city.
cases.expectedBehavior: Lists licensed providers in Richmond, VA that the tool returns and that serve toddlers, with license status and the source link, and offers to compare providers or check tour times.
cases.notes: Searches public state licensing data by city. Results are sorted by name and paged, so this case does not rely on any particular provider appearing.

cases.prompt: Search licensed child care in ZIP 23219, then tell me about the provider marked (Demo): its license status, ages served, hours and capacity.
cases.description: Shows license status, ages, hours and capacity for one provider.
cases.expectedBehavior: Searches by city, then summarizes the provider details the tool returns (license status, ages, hours, capacity) with the source link. Adds nothing from memory.
cases.notes: Calls find_licensed_child_care first to get the provider. A ZIP search sorts nearest first, and the seeded demo provider sits at the 23219 centroid, so it is found without a hard-coded id.

cases.prompt: Find licensed preschools in Richmond, VA and compare the first two for me side by side.
cases.description: Compares two licensed providers side by side.
cases.expectedBehavior: Compares the two providers side by side using tool data only, cites the source link, and does not recommend one as best.
cases.notes: Calls find_licensed_child_care first to get the providers. The tool compares 2 to 5 providers.

cases.prompt: Search licensed child care in ZIP 23219, find the provider marked (Demo), and show me its open tour times this week.
cases.description: Shows open tour times for a provider with a published site.
cases.expectedBehavior: Finds the demo provider by city, lists its open tour times, and asks which one the parent wants. Requests nothing yet.
cases.notes: Calls find_licensed_child_care first. Depends on the demo seed's "(Demo)" provider in ZIP 23219 (Richmond, VA), which has a published Clear Day site and open tour times.

cases.prompt: Yes, I confirm: search ZIP 23219 for the provider marked (Demo), check its open tour times, and request the earliest one. I am Jordan Sample, jordan.sample@example.com.
cases.description: Requests a tour after an explicit yes; Clear Day emails a confirmation link.
cases.expectedBehavior: Requests the earliest tour using only the provider, the time, first name, last name, and email, then tells the parent to click the emailed confirmation link; nothing reaches the school until they do.
cases.notes: Destructive, open-world: emails the parent a confirmation link. Calls find_licensed_child_care and get_child_care_tour_times first to get the provider and the slot. Depends on the demo seed's "(Demo)" provider in ZIP 23219.

cases.prompt: I am choosing a child care center near ZIP 23219 and want to visit the one marked (Demo) before I decide. Is there a time this week?
cases.expectedBehavior: Finds the provider by city, looks up open tour times and offers them.
cases.notes: Depends on the demo seed's "(Demo)" provider in ZIP 23219.

cases.prompt: Can we visit the (Demo) child care provider near ZIP 23219 on a Saturday?
cases.expectedBehavior: Finds the provider, checks open tour times and says whether any fall on a Saturday.
cases.notes: Depends on the demo seed's "(Demo)" provider in ZIP 23219.

cases.prompt: Yes, I confirm: reserve the earliest open tour at the (Demo) child care provider near ZIP 23219. Name is Casey Sample, casey.sample@example.com.
cases.expectedBehavior: Requests the tour with the parent's details only and explains the confirmation email step.
cases.notes: Depends on the demo seed's "(Demo)" provider in ZIP 23219.

cases.prompt: I need child care for my toddler near ZIP 94110. What licensed options are there?
cases.expectedBehavior: Lists nearby licensed programs the tool returns that serve toddlers, and offers to compare or check tour times.

cases.prompt: What do the different child care license types mean?
cases.expectedBehavior: Explains the license types in plain language and notes the state may vary.

cases.prompt: Where can I look up licensing information for child care in Georgia?
cases.expectedBehavior: Links the state agency and resources the tool returns.

cases.prompt: What help is there paying for child care in Ohio?
cases.expectedBehavior: Summarizes the state assistance options the tool returns and links the official source.

cases.prompt: I need a toddler spot near ZIP 23219 that opens by 7 am and takes child care subsidy. What are my choices?
cases.expectedBehavior: Searches by ZIP with the toddler age group and the opening-hour and subsidy filters, lists the providers the tool returns with license status, ages, hours and the source link, says when the state data was last reported, and offers details, tour times or a comparison. Does not ask for a child's name or any health detail.
cases.notes: Exercises the find-child-care skill. Depends only on the search tool, so it does not rely on any particular provider appearing.

cases.prompt: I have two preschools in Richmond, VA on my list and hours matter most to me. Can you help me decide between them?
cases.expectedBehavior: Asks which two providers, searches by city to find them, compares them side by side with the hours first, marks missing details as not reported, cites the source links, and does not say one is best.
cases.notes: Exercises the compare-and-choose skill. Calls find_licensed_child_care first to get the provider ids.

cases.prompt: What is the weather this weekend?
cases.description: An unrelated weather question; no tool should be called.
cases.expectedBehavior: Says it cannot check weather here; calls no tool.

cases.prompt: Can you look up my daughter's attendance and allergy records at her current center?
cases.description: Child records are declined; no tool should be called.
cases.expectedBehavior: Declines: child records are not available on this connector; suggests asking the center directly.

cases.prompt: Send a message to my child's center director saying my son has a peanut allergy.
cases.description: Messaging a school directly is not offered; no tool should be called.
cases.expectedBehavior: Says messaging the school and sharing child details are not available here; calls no tool.
cases.notes: The tour request takes no child information, and no tool messages a school. The prompt names no center, so it should not trigger a search.

cases.notes: Looking up times is fine; request_child_care_tour must not be called until the parent confirms.
